_comment: Audium (Lavalink v4 node) — Pterodactyl egg that DOWNLOADS the prebuilt Linux binary from GitHub Releases at install time and runs it. No Rust/C++/CMake/Cargo on the host. Logs stream to the Console tab. See ../DEPLOYMENT.md.
name: Audium (Lavalink v4 node, prebuilt download)
author: CodeX Development
description: Audium — a native Rust Lavalink v4 audio node. This egg downloads the correct prebuilt release binary (kizunalink-linux-x86_64-musl on x86_64, kizunalink-linux-arm64 on ARM64), verifies its SHA-256, and runs it. Nothing is compiled on the host. Startup Variables are injected into config.toml on every boot, and all runtime logs stream to the Console tab (console-only logging by default; file logging is opt-in).

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Audium (prebuilt-binary) installer.
#
# Downloads the correct prebuilt Linux binary from GitHub Releases at install
# time, verifies its SHA-256, and writes a start.sh wrapper. No Rust toolchain,
# C++ compiler, CMake or Cargo is required on the panel host.
set -e

REPO="Nikhil309-dev/Kizunalink"
BASE="https://github.com/${REPO}/releases/latest/download"

# Pick the asset for this machine's architecture.
ARCH="$(uname -m)"
case "$ARCH" in
    x86_64|amd64)  ASSET="kizunalink-linux-x86_64-musl" ;;   # fully static
    aarch64|arm64) ASSET="kizunalink-linux-arm64" ;;         # glibc >= 2.34
    *) echo "[audium] Unsupported architecture: $ARCH"; exit 1 ;;
esac

mkdir -p /mnt/server/logs
cd /mnt/server

echo "[audium] Downloading ${ASSET} ..."
if ! curl -fSL --retry 3 -o "${ASSET}" "${BASE}/${ASSET}"; then
    echo "[audium] Download failed. Check the release and network access."
    exit 1
fi

if curl -fSL --retry 3 -o "${ASSET}.sha256" "${BASE}/${ASSET}.sha256"; then
    echo "[audium] Verifying SHA-256 ..."
    if ! sha256sum -c "${ASSET}.sha256"; then
        echo "[audium] Checksum mismatch. Refusing to install a corrupt binary."
        exit 1
    fi
    rm -f "${ASSET}.sha256"
else
    echo "[audium] warning: no checksum published for ${ASSET}; skipping verification"
fi

chmod +x "${ASSET}"

# start.sh injects the panel's Startup Variables into config.toml on every boot.
# This is required because some published binaries predate AUDIUM_* environment
# overrides and read config.toml only -- the panel variables must win regardless.
# The default config logs to the CONSOLE only (no [logging.file] section), so the
# Pterodactyl Console tab shows all startup/API/player/error logs out of the box.
cat > start.sh <<EOF
#!/bin/bash
set -e
cd /home/container

: "\${AUDIUM_AUTHORIZATION:?Set the Authorization Secret in the panel Startup tab}"
ADDR="\${AUDIUM_ADDRESS:-0.0.0.0}"
PORT="\${AUDIUM_PORT:-2333}"
LEVEL="\${AUDIUM_LOG_LEVEL:-info}"

if [ ! -f config.toml ]; then
    cat > config.toml <<'CFG'
[server]
address = "0.0.0.0"
port = 2333
authorization = "unset-until-injected"
player_update_interval = 5
stats_interval = 30
websocket_ping_interval = 20
max_event_queue_size = 100
rate_limit_per_minute = 2000

[logging]
level = "info"
CFG
fi

# Rewrite address / port / authorization / level inside their sections only, so
# any other settings the user added to config.toml are preserved.
awk -v a="\$ADDR" -v p="\$PORT" -v k="\$AUDIUM_AUTHORIZATION" -v lvl="\$LEVEL" '
  /^[[:space:]]*\[/ { sec=\$0 }
  sec=="[server]" && \$0 ~ /^[[:space:]]*address[[:space:]]*=/       { print "address = \\"" a "\\""; next }
  sec=="[server]" && \$0 ~ /^[[:space:]]*port[[:space:]]*=/          { print "port = " p; next }
  sec=="[server]" && \$0 ~ /^[[:space:]]*authorization[[:space:]]*=/ { print "authorization = \\"" k "\\""; next }
  sec=="[logging]" && \$0 ~ /^[[:space:]]*level[[:space:]]*=/        { print "level = \\"" lvl "\\""; next }
  { print }
' config.toml > config.toml.tmp && mv config.toml.tmp config.toml

# Also export the level for builds that support AUDIUM_* env overrides.
export AUDIUM_LOG_LEVEL="\$LEVEL"

exec ./${ASSET}
EOF
chmod +x start.sh

echo "[audium] Install complete. Binary: ${ASSET}"

variables.name: Authorization Secret
variables.description: Required. Strong random secret clients use as the Lavalink password. Generate with: openssl rand -hex 32

variables.name: Bind Address
variables.description: Interface to listen on. Keep 0.0.0.0 so the panel can route the allocation to the process.

variables.name: Port
variables.description: Port to listen on. Must equal the primary allocation port the panel shows for this server.

variables.name: Log Level
variables.description: Console log verbosity: trace | debug | info | warn | error | off. Injected into config.toml and exported as AUDIUM_LOG_LEVEL.

variables.name: Rate Limit Per Minute
variables.description: Per-IP request cap over REST + WS upgrade. 0 disables.
